items.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high fidelity Russian-language UI design reference for the existing Enix Fit strength training product. This is a raster design mockup, clean readable real interface, not a wireframe. Keep current brand: logo is three ascending round-ended blue/lavender bars followed by "Enix Fit". Fitness web visual identity: near black navy #0b111b background, sidebar #0e1723, elevated slate panels #121b26 and #151f2e, thin #243143 borders, white #f4f6ff type, muted #9cacc6, primary periwinkle blue #6390ff to #454beb subtle gradient, mint green #70dfac for saved/completed, amber for pending decisions. Modern neutral sans type similar current Fit Sans/Arial; restrained 14px rounded corners and line icons. Professional and quiet, ample hierarchy, tightly aligned grid, no neon, no giant rounded bubbles. Excellent legible Cyrillic typography with real text. Numbers are illustrative demo data. Do not advertise fake user counts, unimplemented health integrations, AI chat, readiness scores, calories, social feed or unrelated features. Any explanatory recommendation must be presented as a proposal requiring approval. Render flat front view without desktop hardware, perspective, busy backgrounds or watermark. Asset: single complete desktop public homepage design, tall portrait canvas approximately 1440x1900. Show the complete landing page with consistent generous spacing, not a collage. Top nav brand / Возможности / Как это работает / Для тренеров / Войти / Начать бесплатно. Dramatic subdued mountain ridgeline photography in near black blue background, current Enix Fit mountain identity, faint athlete silhouette at far right. Large left hero exact text "Тренируйся осознанно." then blue "Знай следующий шаг." Small supporting copy "Записывай подходы, следи за прогрессом и понимай следующую нагрузку." Primary CTA "Начать бесплатно", secondary "Посмотреть демо", trust row "Без карты · Дневник без ограничений". Right hero is a large product dashboard preview showing "Сегодня: Верх тела", workout start action, bench press plan and mint completed sets; a small phone overlay shows set logging. Under hero a compact three-step strip "Программа → Тренировка → Следующая цель". Lower sections three rich feature cards "Дневник", "Прогресс", "Вместе с тренером", then a wide section with exact title "Следующая нагрузка с понятным объяснением", a proposal example "Жим лёжа: 60 → 62,5 кг", button "Почему такая цель?" and "Подтвердить". Add caption "Концепция следующего релиза". Bottom 3 pricing cards Free "0 ₽" unlimited diary/RIR/history; Pro "349 ₽ / мес." recommendations/explanations; "Для тренеров" "1 390 ₽ / мес." up to 5 active clients/approval. Label pricing heading subtitle "Гипотеза для пилота". Compact mountain closing CTA and footer. Large readable visual reference, premium but matches existing dark landing style.
